Brackenridge Civil Group Incwww.brackenridgecivil.com
June 25, 2004
David Dyer, General Manager, Johnson PLC
Dear Mr. Dyer:
This letter sets out the terms on which this office will prepare a stormwater
management plan for Johnson PLC. When you have read it and returned a signed
copy, it will serve as our agreement for the work. The terms below govern how we
will proceed, what we will deliver, and what each of us is responsible for.
The Work
We will prepare a complete stormwater management plan for the site. The plan will
address the drainage of the developed property, the detention of stormwater to
control the rate of runoff, and the treatment of that runoff for water quality. It will be
prepared to the standards of the regional water authority that reviews such plans in
this jurisdiction. Our drawings will be issued under a sealed cover sheet, and the
calculations that support them will be included in the submission.
The work proceeds in the order the design requires. We begin with the survey and
topographic data for the site and the drainage areas they define. We build the
hydrologic and hydraulic model from that base and establish the flows the plan must
manage. We then size the detention and water quality facilities to meet the required
release rates and prepare the erosion and sediment control plan that accompanies
the design. When the design is set, we assemble the plan set and the supporting
calculations for submission and for the reviewing agency's examination. Our fee
includes one round of response to that agency's written comments.
Assignments
Pamela Warren, Project Engineer, will lead the design and carry the coordination with
the regional water authority's reviewers. Charles Olson and Jeffrey Perez, Design
T echnicians, will prepare the plan sheets and the utility and stormwater drafting from
her direction. I will review every sheet and seal the completed set. Any
correspondence to the reviewing agency or to another public body will be issued over
my signature. You may direct questions on the day-to-day work to Pamela Warren,
and questions on scope, fee, or the terms of this agreement to me.
Brackenridge Civil Group Inc

Information and Reliance
Our design will rely on the accuracy of the survey, the boundary information, and the
site plan furnished to us or prepared under separate agreement. We will review that
information for consistency, but we are entitled to rely on it and are not responsible
for errors it contains. If the survey or the site plan changes after we have begun, the
change may affect the design, the schedule, and the fee, and we will advise you of
the effect before we act on it.
Fee and Start of Work
Our fee for the work described above is a fixed sum of $46,000. The fee covers the
design, the plan set, the supporting calculations, and the single round of response to
the reviewing agency noted above. We will begin the work on July 5, 2004. Services
beyond this scope, including additional review cycles, redesign to accommodate a
change in the site plan, or attendance at hearings, will be undertaken only with your
written authorization, and we will quote the additional cost before we proceed.
Invoicing and Payment
We will invoice monthly, in proportion to the work completed in the period. Each
invoice is payable within thirty days of its date. Reimbursable expenses, including
reproduction, agency fees, and delivery, are billed at cost and are in addition to the
fee. Should an account remain unpaid sixty days after its date, we may, at our
discretion, suspend work until the balance is brought current, and we will give you
written notice before we do so. A suspension for non-payment extends our schedule
by the length of the suspension.
Term and Termination
This agreement takes effect on the date work begins and continues until the plan set
has been submitted and the reviewing agency's first round of comments has been
answered. Either party may terminate the agreement on ten days' written notice to
the other. On termination by you, you will pay for the services performed and the
expenses incurred through the date of termination. The drawings, calculations, and
files we prepare are our instruments of service and remain our property; on payment
in full you are granted the use of them for this project.
Confidentiality
We will hold in confidence the site information, financial figures, and development
plans you provide to us, and we will use them only to perform this work. We may
disclose what a reviewing agency reasonably requires for its review, and what a court

or a public body compels by law. This obligation survives the completion or
termination of the work.
Limitation of Liability
We will perform this work with the care and skill ordinarily exercised by civil
engineers practicing in this locality at this time. We make no other warranty, express
or implied. Our total liability to Johnson PLC for any claim arising out of or related to
this work, whether in contract or in tort, is limited to the amount of the fee paid
under this agreement. We are not responsible for the means, methods, or safety of
construction, nor for the acts or omissions of contractors or others not under our
direct control.
Governing Law
This agreement is governed by the laws of the state in which the site is located. Any
dispute arising under it that we cannot resolve between us will be submitted to the
courts of that state.
Schedule
The work runs about five months from the start. We can hold that schedule so long as
the survey and the site information reach us when they are needed and the reviewing
agency responds within its usual time. Delay in either is outside our control. Should
one threaten the completion of the work, we will tell you promptly and propose how
to recover the time. We do not build float into the schedule for circumstances we
cannot foresee, and we will not represent that we can.
Acceptance
If these terms meet with your approval, please sign both copies of this letter where
indicated and return one copy to this office. On receipt, we will schedule the work to
begin on the date stated above. Should any term require discussion, please
telephone me and we will settle it before the work commences.
Sincerely,
Mark Todd
Principal Engineer
Date: June 25, 2004
Brackenridge Civil Group Inc
